name: Gritty Business
summary: Quinn in Gadgetzan offers a share of the coin for salvage from machines in the desert. She plans to sell the parts to junkers.

sections.title: A Share of the Salvage
sections.body: Quinn has silver waiting in Gadgetzan, where she means to sort and sell what you bring back. The desert machines shed parts that tech-heads may value as fuel-cell material. Quinn wants you to bring her seven pieces of Desert Debris, and promises a share of the coin from the sale.

faq.q: Who is asking for the debris?
faq.answer: Quinn in Gadgetzan is asking you to recover Desert Debris from machines in the desert.

faq.q: What does Quinn want me to bring back?
faq.answer: Quinn wants seven pieces of Desert Debris.

faq.q: Why does Quinn want the machine parts?
faq.answer: Quinn plans to sell the salvage to junkers who may use the parts as fuel-cell material.

faq.q: What does Quinn offer in return?
faq.answer: Quinn promises you a share of the coin from selling the salvage.
